I replied to Nadia in the #strategic-pod thread. Gideon's final number for Vantorre Group was 280 seats.

His Jul 1 update first said 300, and about five minutes later he corrected it to 280. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The production roster that day showed 280 active seats, so 280 is the number for her roster sheet.
